import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
b62_txt = """   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V

L=b62_txt.strip().split("\n"); aas=L[0].split(); idx={a:i for i,a in enumerate(aas)}
S=np.zeros((20,20),int)
for ln in L[1:]:
    p=ln.split()
    for j,a2 in enumerate(aas): S[idx[p[0]],idx[a2]]=int(p[j+1])

def sw(a,b,go=11,ge=1):
    ai=np.array([idx[c] for c in a]); bi=np.array([idx[c] for c in b])
    n,m=len(a),len(b); prevH=np.zeros(m+1); prevF=np.full(m+1,-1e9); best=0.0
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        sr=S[ai[i-1]][bi]  # length m
        H=np.zeros(m+1); F=np.full(m+1,-1e9); E=-1e9
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            E=max(E-ge, H[j-1]-go-ge)
            F[j]=max(prevF[j]-ge, prevH[j]-go-ge)
            v=max(0.0, prevH[j-1]+sr[j-1], E, F[j]); H[j]=v
            if v>best: best=v
        prevH,prevF=H,F
    return best

A="MDDTLSTVEGGMTETSSWSTTIATTTTTEAAKAGSMAVGIIVLIVVMVLLCCLLIICLPLLCLCGCCGLACSACLACDEGCCGEGGGGGCCGDDGGGCCGDGGGCGDCGDGCGDCTLDDD"
B="MAELDATTLSEYDIEYIDFNMTTVAYRTTTGHPDTNLGAWGLLFIFVVIFLIIAACCACMGVLVLFGCMKSFLCFRCRRRGDEFIGREP"
obs=sw(A,B); print("observed CG13494 vs CG43405 SW score:",obs)

r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",
    params={"query":"(proteome:UP000000803) AND (length:[80 TO 130])","format":"fasta"}, timeout=50)
recs=[]
for blk in r.text.split("\n>"):
    blk=blk.lstrip(">")
    if not blk.strip(): continue
    h,*s=blk.split("\n"); recs.append((h.split("|")[-1].split()[0] if "|" in h else h, "".join(s).replace("*","")))
ok=set("ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV")
recs=[(h,s) for h,s in recs if set(s)<=ok and 80<=len(s)<=130 and "CG13494" not in h and "CG43405" not in h]
rng=np.random.default_rng(7)
sel=[recs[i] for i in rng.choice(len(recs), size=min(450,len(recs)), replace=False)]
print("null set: ",len(sel)," random D. melanogaster proteins of 80-130 aa")
scores=np.array([sw(A,s) for h,s in sel])
print(f"null SW scores: mean {scores.mean():.1f} sd {scores.std():.1f} median {np.median(scores):.0f} 95th {np.percentile(scores,95):.0f} 99th {np.percentile(scores,99):.0f} max {scores.max():.0f}")
print(f"P(null >= {obs:.0f}) = {(scores>=obs).mean():.4f}  ({int((scores>=obs).sum())}/{len(scores)})")
print("top null hits:", sorted(zip(scores,[h for h,s in sel]),reverse=True)[:5])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7,4))
ax.hist(scores,bins=45,color="#9aa6b2",label=f"{len(scores)} random D. melanogaster proteins, 80-130 aa")
ax.axvline(obs,color="#c0392b",lw=2.5,label=f"CG13494 vs neighbour CG43405 = {obs:.0f}")
ax.set_xlabel("Smith-Waterman score vs CG13494 (BLOSUM62, gap 11/1)"); ax.set_ylabel("proteins")
ax.set_title("CG13494 resembles its 147 bp neighbour CG43405 far more than chance")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
